Ninety-eight percent planned it. Thirty-seven did it.
Sound like your savings plan? Watch this.
Farmers in western Kenya. A little fertilizer paid back about thirty-six percent in one season.
Almost all of them said: next season, I'll buy it.
But by planting time, the harvest money was gone.
So researchers tried one thing. Right after harvest, normal price, free delivery.
Fertilizer use jumped, about eleven points.
The same offer, a few months later?
So decide while the money is in your hand. Not someday.
